answer.reason: The verses tell of Abner setting up Ishbosheth, killing Asahel, and turning to David, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: took Ishbosheth to Mahanaim and made him king over Israel
clauses.quote: took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim

clauses.english: killed Asahel with his spear when Asahel would not stop pursuing him
clauses.quote: Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib

clauses.english: went to David at Hebron and promised to gather all Israel to him
clauses.quote: I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king

doubts: His death at Joab's hand (2SA 3:27) is left out because the summary already gives it.
1CH 27:21 names Jaasiel son of Abner, and 1CH 26:28 names an Abner who dedicated spoils. I left both out as lists that add no deed.
